Component(Object object)

  • Creates a custom component and accepts a parameter of the Object type.

Parameter

Object object

Definition Field Type Mandatory or Not Description
properties Object Map No External properties of the component, which form a map between property names and property settings.
data Object No Internal data of the component, which is used together with properties to render the template of the component.
methods Object No Component methods, including event response functions and any custom methods. For the use of event response functions, see Events and Communication Between Components.
behaviors String Array No Inter-component code reuse mechanism similar to mixins and traits. For details, see behaviors.
created Function No Component lifecycle function executed when a component instance is created. Note that setData cannot be called in this function.
attached Function No Component lifecycle function executed when a component instance enters the page node tree.
ready Function No Component lifecycle function executed when the component layout is completed.
moved Function No Component lifecycle function executed when a component instance is moved to another node in the node tree.
detached Function No Component lifecycle function executed when a component instance is removed from the page node tree.

The generated component instance can be accessed through this in the component methods, lifecycle functions, and observer properties. A component contains common properties and methods.

Attribute Type Description
is String File path of the component.
id String Node ID.
dataset String Node dataset.
data Object Component data, including internal data and property values.
properties Object Component data, including internal data and property values (consistent with data).
Method Parameter Description
setData Object newData Sets data and performs view layer rendering.
triggerEvent String name, Object detail, Object options Triggers events. For details, see Events and Communication Between Components .
createSelectorQuery Creates a SelectorQuery object. The range of the selector is within the component instance.

Sample Code

Component({

  behaviors: [],

  // Property definition (described in the following).
  properties: {
    myProperty: { // Property name.
      type: String,
      value: ''
    },
    myProperty2: String // Simplified definition mode.
  },

  data: {}, // Private data, which can be used for template rendering.


    // Lifecycle function, which can be a function or a method name defined in methods.
    attached: function () { },
    moved: function () { },



  methods: {
    onMyButtonTap: function(){
      this.setData({
        // The method of updating properties and data is similar to that of updating page data.
      })
    },
    // It is recommended that an internal method start with an underscore (_).
    _myPrivateMethod: function(){
      // Set data.A[0].B to 'myPrivateData'.
      this.setData({
        'A[0].B': 'myPrivateData'
      })
    },
    _propertyChange: function(newVal, oldVal) {

    }
  }

})

Note: In the properties definition field, the property name is in camel case (propertyName). In a maml file, the property name uses hyphens (component-tag-name property-name="attr value"). When applied in data binding, the property name is in camel case.

Definition of properties

Definition Field Type Mandatory or Not Description
type Yes Type of the property.
value No Initial value of the property.
observer Function/String No Callback function at the change of the property value.

You can use observer to listen for property value changes. observer in function type binds code logic, and in string type binds method names.

Note: The type field is mandatory.

Sample Code

Component({
properties: {
  min: {
  type: Number,
    value: 0
},
  min: {
  type: Number,
    value: 0,
  observer: function(newVal, oldVal) {
      // Executed when the property value changes.
    }
  },
  lastLeaf: {
    //The property type can be Number, String, or Boolean.
    type: Number,
    value: 0
  }
}})

The property type can be String, Number, Boolean, Object, or Array. The value null indicates that the property type is not limited.

In most cases, specify a type for the property. When a property value is literally specified in MAML, the value can have an exact type, for example:

<custom-comp min="1" max="5" />

Because the property type of the custom component is Number, the values of min and max are assigned as 1 and 5 instead of "1"and "5".

  this.data.min === 1 // true
  this.data.max === 5 // true

Bug & Tip

  • You can use this.data to obtain internal data and property values, but directly changing the values does not apply the changes to the GUI. You can use setData to modify this.data.
  • The lifecycle functions cannot be accessed through this in the component methods.
    • Do not start a property name with data, that is, do not name a property in the format of dataXyz, because in MAML, data-xyz="" is processed as a node dataset instead of a component property.
  • In component definition and use, the property names and data fields of a component cannot conflict with each other (although they are in different definition fields).
